notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am publishing the new update, to correct the error that occurred when opening the game, and did close automatically without any message.

I apologize now for the delay in making this update, I had a lot of problems this year, and I had to move away from development (I won't go into details). But I'm coming back now, and I will pay more attention to the project.

Soon I will release new updates, including finally the achievements, which are still disabled.

Sorry everyone who has been waiting for this update for so long.

tags.bug: to correct the error that occurred when opening the game, and did close automatically without any message.

tags.feature: finally the achievements, which are still disabled.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.36
notes.content:
- Correction of some bugs.

Attention:

I momentarily deactivated the achievements, because the module that releases with the Steam API (third-party module) is not working properly, and it is the one that is causing the problem to start in Windows 10, forcing the game to close.

As soon as I decide to launch a new update releasing the achievements.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.34
notes.content:
I have just released the latest update, and some issues have been fixed:

- Fix crash fix at startup in Windows 10.
- Revised the collisions of some elements.
- Improvement in ambient sound (in the caves)
- Bats follow in a more random way.
- Other small fixes.
- Added more boxes.

Sorry for the delay in launching this update!

tags.bug: - Fix crash fix at startup in Windows 10.
- Revised the collisions of some elements.

notes.title: Release Notes 1.33 - Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone, finally I was able to implement the consquistas in the game.

I have created some in key points of the journey. I also fixed some minor bugs, and improved the lighting in some phases.

Remembering that even released I'm still working to polish the game even more.

tags.feature: I have created some in key points of the journey.

tags.bug: I also fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: Update Notes 1.002
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you are enjoying the game. I just posted the first update to fix some issues. As the following:

[list]
[*]Messages can now be skipped.
[*]Boxes are dragged more easily.
[*]I improved the speed of the princess not to run too much.
[*]The daggers no longer collide with items and coins.
[/list]

Soon I will release new updates with improvements and new maps.

See you later!

tags.bug: [*]The daggers no longer collide with items and coins.
